response.overview: Kezdetben Ketten is a Hungarian audiovisual art project. It combines music, film and artistic storytelling. The work references the film Jambo Jambo. It also incorporates elements from the biblical story of Adam and Eve. Its main themes include love, human connection, innocence and the beginning of a relationship. Music plays an important role in creating its unique atmosphere. Different artistic and cultural references blend together throughout the work. Overall, it offers a personal and creative interpretation of the idea of two people beginning their story together.
response.tagline: “In the beginning, there were two — one story, endless possibilities.”
response.title: Kezdetben ketten
